## Summary

On **16 October 2026**, the [UMR EcoFoG](https://umr-ecofog.cirad.fr/) hosts two scientific conferences "from Brasil" by **Flavia Costa** and **Alberto Vicentini**: *HydrAmazonia Project* and *Beyond Species Names*. This is a good opportunity to discover **HidrAmazônia**, our Franco-Brazilian project on how Amazonian forests cope with droughts and floods.

## Practical information

- **Date:** Friday 16 October 2026, 11:00 (Cayenne time)
- **Place:** Campus agronomique, Silvolab room
- **Format:** in person and online
- **Programme:** *HydrAmazonia Project* & *Beyond Species Names*
- **Speakers:** Flavia Costa and Alberto Vicentini

More details are available on the [EcoFoG event page](https://umr-ecofog.cirad.fr/science-pour-tous/animations-scientifiques/deux-presentations-16-10-2026).
